# authentik-sdk

> Single sign-on against authentik for Node applications. One group per
> application is the entire access model. Roles are never derived from authentik.

## What this package does

Adds authentik sign-in (OIDC authorization code + PKCE) to a JavaScript or
TypeScript application, and decides whether the signed-in user may use the
application at all. It does not manage roles, permissions, or users.

## The access rule, in full

1. Create one group per application in authentik, e.g. `myapp-access`.
2. If the signed-in user's group list contains that group, they may use the app.
3. Otherwise they are denied.
4. Roles are the application's own concern and must not be set from authentik.

## Install

```bash
npm install github:rmachhh/authentik-sdk
```

Or pinned:

```json
{ "dependencies": { "authentik-sdk": "github:rmachhh/authentik-sdk#v0.2.0" } }
```

`openid-client` is installed automatically. It is only used by the sign-in
client, which loads lazily, so an application that only needs the access check
does not load it.

## Minimal integration

`SETUP.md` in this repository contains the complete, exact code to add. Follow it
literally rather than inventing the wiring.

The shape, for orientation:

```js
import { createSessionStore, defineAccessPolicy, loadAuthentikClient } from "authentik-sdk";

const { createAuthentikClient } = await loadAuthentikClient();
const auth = createAuthentikClient({ issuer, clientId, clientSecret, redirectUri });
const access = defineAccessPolicy({ appGroup: "myapp-access" });

// start:  auth.authorizationUrl(flowId, createSessionStore(session))
// finish: auth.completeLogin(new URL(req.originalUrl, auth.redirectUri), flowId, store)
// decide: access.check(claims).allowed
```

## Required environment

| Variable | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTHENTIK_ISSUER` | `https://id.example.com/application/o/myapp/` | Trailing slash matters |
| `AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_ID` | `myapp` | From the provider |
| `AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_SECRET` | | Server-side only, never in a browser bundle |
| `AUTHENTIK_REDIRECT_URI` | `https://myapp.example.com/auth/callback` | Must match the provider exactly |
| `APP_GROUP` | `myapp-access` | The group that grants access |

## API

| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `createAuthentikClient(options)` via `loadAuthentikClient()` | Sign-in: `authorizationUrl()`, `completeLogin()` |
| `defineAccessPolicy({ appGroup })` | `check(claims)` returns `{ allowed, groups, roles }` |
| `createSessionStore(session)` | Store the flow state on a session |
| `createMemoryStore(holder)` | Store the flow state on any Map-like object |
| `createEphemeralStore(ttlMs)` | For tests and short-lived processes |
| `extractGroups(claims)` | The group list, tolerant of claim shapes |
| `isMemberOfAppGroup(groups, group)` | The access decision alone |

## Failover

Pass `instances: [...]` instead of a single issuer. The first reachable instance
is used. The instance that started a sign-in is recorded, because a code can only
be exchanged by its issuer. Configuration errors are not failed over.

## Rules an agent must not break

- Never assign roles or permissions from the groups claim.
- Never treat an empty group list as "no access" when the user already has local
  roles; leave existing access alone.
- Never log tokens, codes or client secrets.
- Never default `appGroup` to something permissive. No group configured means
  deny everything.
- Never send the PKCE verifier, state or nonce to the browser in readable form.
- Do not use `allowInsecure: true` outside local development.

## Verifying the work

1. `npm test` — 54 tests, no credentials needed.
2. With credentials, `AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_SECRET=... npm test` adds live checks
   against a running authentik.
3. `node examples/integration.js` prints configuration, the PKCE URL, a refused
   forged callback, and the access decision.
4. `node examples/express-app.js` runs a complete working application.

## Documentation

- `SETUP.md` — the exact code to add, with a verification step
- `README.md` — full API reference
- `AGENTS.md` — conventions for agents contributing to this repository
